params.body:
Fifth card, reading the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#174 writes for `vuln`.

- The card's level is the worst of Elixir's `runtime` and `packages` verdicts; the malware line takes the `malware` verdict. The ladder next to them (critical this week, high a month, the rest background) stays as fallback for a row written before Elixir judged, and goes in the follow-up after the Monday round.
- One `Judged` line names the thresholds that fired.

Behaviour on current rows unchanged. Two new tests in `VulnerabilityCardTest`. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean. Either merge order works.
params.title: The Packages card reads Elixir's verdict per facet
